installation_scope_valid.name: installation_scope_valid
installation_scope_valid.value: ("slack_installations"."is_enterprise" AND "slack_installations"."enterprise_id" IS NOT NULL AND "slack_installations"."workspace_id" IS NULL) OR (NOT "slack_installations"."is_enterprise" AND "slack_installations"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

ritual_result_range.name: ritual_result_range
ritual_result_range.value: abs("ritual_results"."baseline") <= 1000000000 AND abs("ritual_results"."current_value") <= 1000000000 AND abs("ritual_results"."target") <= 1000000000 AND "ritual_results"."baseline" <> "ritual_results"."target"
